recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future corrections to variant change naming or variation-code semantics should be made in HL7/genomics-reporting or the owning external artifact, not in the FHIR core checkout unless Clinical Genomics explicitly moves that content back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-13832 asked to rename Observation-geneticsVariant to Observation-geneticsDNAVariantChange and clarify the definition from generic variant information to DNA variant change information. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution said the spirit of this change had already been applied in the Genomics Reporting IG at the described-variant variation-code component.
initial_application: No FHIR-13832-specific core source commit was found. Clinical Genomics minutes approved FHIR-13832 with FHIR-13833 and FHIR-13835 as already applied to the Genomics Reporting IG but not to Observation-genetics in FHIR Core. Later core history redirected genetics guidance to the Genomics Reporting IG and removed outdated clinical genomics artifacts from Observation, DiagnosticReport, and ServiceRequest.
additional_context: Current FHIR core still builds Observation, but it has no active Observation-genetics profile or Observation-geneticsDNAVariantChange source target. Core narrative points genomic result implementers to the Genomics Reporting IG. The FHIR Extension Pack retains the legacy observation-geneticsVariant extension only as retired/deprecated content replaced by the Genomics Reporting Guide, while the current Genomics Reporting IG Variant profile includes a variation-code component for variant database accessions.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because the accepted application target is outside this checkout and reviving or renaming retired Observation-genetics content in core would be outside current build scope.
